newsitem.title: JAPAN: Forex law changes won't affect market--Sakakibara.
newsitem.headline: Forex law changes won't affect market--Sakakibara.

text.p: Planned changes in Japan's foreign exchange laws should not have a major impact on financial markets, senior Finance Ministry official Eisuke Sakakibara said on Tuesday.

"Foreign exchange transactions are liberalised among professionals already. I don't think there will be a big impact from the foreign exchange law changes on the financial markets," Sakakibara, head of the ministry's International Finance Bureau, told a parliamentary committee.
He had been asked what impact the changes, part Japan's "Big Bang" financial reforms, would have on foreign exchange rates and domestic interest rates.
